summary: Reported: s09 drivers/greybus/gb-beagleplay.c:204-214 hdlc_rx_greybus_frame passes peer le16 hdr.size verbatim to greybus_data_rcvd (line 213) while ignoring the locally known frame length (len = rx_buffer_len - 4, line 357, delivered at line 368); TX sibling clamps at line 602 (RX_HDLC_PAYLOAD) but the RX path does not; downstream gb_connection_recv (operation.c:1048-1049) re-reads msg_size from the same peer bytes so its size < msg_size check is vacuous; consuming memcpy at operation.c:651 copies peer-declared size bytes out of the fixed 259-byte rx_buffer. The intent-named urb->actual_length target (es2.c cport_in_callback line 834/844) was deep-read and classified safe (HCI-bounded actual_length, es2-allocated buffers).
